title: Michelin Guide Seoul 2026: All Stars, All Restaurants, All Reviews
description: The complete Michelin Guide Seoul 2026 — every starred restaurant, Bib Gourmand pick, and what to order. With reservation tips.
content:
The Michelin Guide Seoul 2026 edition maintains Seoul's position as one of Asia's premier fine dining destinations, with 32 starred restaurants across the city — including a remarkable 6 three-star establishments.

Three-Star Restaurants (⭐⭐⭐)

Three stars: "Exceptional cuisine, worth a special journey."

  • Gaon (가온) — The gold standard for modern Korean cuisine. 11-course tasting menu presenting Korean flavors through French technique. ₩350,000/person. Reserve 2 months ahead.
  • Jungsik — Jung Sik Yim's flagship. Contemporary Korean with global sensibility. ₩280,000/person.
  • La Yeon (라연) — At The Shilla Hotel. Traditional royal Korean court cuisine elevated to its highest form.

Two-Star Restaurants (⭐⭐)

  • Mingles — Innovative, seasonal, brilliant. Wine list is outstanding.
  • Mosu Seoul — Monthly changing menu. Ahn Sung-jae's cooking is consistently revelatory.
  • Soil — Fermentation-focused. Every dish involves at least one fermented Korean ingredient.
💡 Reservation Reality: Three-star restaurants typically open reservations exactly 60 days in advance online. Set alarms. Be ready to try for several months.

Best Bib Gourmand Picks (Value Picks)

Bib Gourmand means outstanding food at modest prices (under ~₩35,000):

  • Gwangjang Market Bindaetteok — The mung bean pancake stalls at the market entrance
  • Mapo Galmaegi Restaurant Strip — Multiple Bib choices for grilled pork skirts
  • Sinchon Ox Bone Soup (설렁탕) — Several shops, open 24 hours
